opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers in the humanities or social sciences based at a UK university or research organisation, British or EEA nationals, holding a doctorate, post‑doctoral status, and not yet in a permanent academic post.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year non‑renewable fellowships (80 % of salary costs) for early‑career researchers to undertake independent, publishable research.

opportunities.title: APEX Awards

amount.raw: Applicants can apply for up to £200,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers with a strong track record, based at a UK university or not‑for‑profit research organisation, able to lead interdisciplinary collaborations across Academy remits.
opportunities.summary: Up to 24‑month interdisciplinary seed grants (maximum £200,000) to support collaborative research across humanities, social sciences, engineering and natural sciences.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers (post‑doctoral or higher) at a UK university or research institute, wishing to develop new quantitative, digital or language skills.
opportunities.summary: Six‑ to twelve‑month awards (max £10,000) to support skill‑development activities, collaborations or dissemination for early‑career, mid‑career or senior researchers.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027

amount.raw: Total funding available per award is up to £300,000 over 2 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators in humanities or social sciences, with international co‑applicants, undertaking genuinely interdisciplinary projects on mobilities.
opportunities.summary: Up to £300,000 (80 % FEC) over two years for interdisciplinary research involving UK and overseas partners, addressing people, materials, things, ideas and narratives.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: DGAP 2026-27

amount.raw: Awards for up to £150,000 for 12 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career or mid‑career UK‑based researchers in humanities or social sciences, interested in policy‑relevant work, able to be based in Berlin with DGAP.
opportunities.summary: Two one‑year fellowships (up to £150,000 each, 80 % FEC) to develop skills and networks across cultural, public, private and policy sectors.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs

amount.raw: Funding of up to £4,000 (higher amounts possible in exceptional circumstances)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within six months, who need support for equipment, caring, accessibility or application assistance.
opportunities.summary: Up to £4,000 (exceptionally higher) per case to cover equipment, caring costs, accessibility aids or support for preparing other British Academy applications.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based researchers at any career stage in humanities or social sciences, able to partner with a GLAM or performing‑arts organisation.
opportunities.summary: Public‑engagement projects funded up to £8,000 (April 2027‑Dec 2028) to develop innovative ways of bringing research to audiences.

opportunities.title: Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers based in the UK or Germany, in humanities or social sciences, eligible to attend a three‑day symposium in April 2027.
opportunities.summary: Symposium participation funded (travel, accommodation, visa) for up to ~15 UK early‑career scholars; seed funding available for collaborative projects arising from the event.
